devdoc.details: This is a HIGH-LEVEL skeleton showing structure for: - Stake ASTERDAO + BNB (gas/treasury) - Daily rewards 1%-1.5% dynamic by totalStaked pool size (for up to 10 days example) - Auto/claimable daily distribution (use Chainlink Keeper or user claim) - Time-based early exit penalty (0-10d:70%, 10-20d:80%, 20-30d:90%, 30d+:100%) - Single active stake per address (no re-stake until redeem) - Referral system up to 16 levels with % on static rewards (10%/6%/4%/2%) - 10% static weighted to LP stakers, 2% to NFT holders (loop over 30 NFTs ok) - Max stake ~5000U equivalent, effective user >50U - Bind referrer, dynamic 2 token down / 1 token back (from treasury or allocation) - All deducted penalties to blackhole - Integrate with ASTER token (0x000ae314e2a2172a039b26378814c252734f556a) for LP dividend if needed IMPORTANT: - Rewards paid FROM staking pool balance (tokens taken out of pool) - High APY unsustainable without massive continuous inflow (taxes, new stakes) - Auto daily send requires off-chain keeper (Chainlink Automation) calling distributeForUser or batch - For production: add pausable, more events, gas optimization, Merkle for referrals if needed, LP/NFT integration - MUST be audited + economic model simulation before deploy - BNB sent on stake can go to treasury for keeper gas reimbursement (off-chain) or project use User flow example: 1. User approves ASTERDAO to this contract 2. Call stake(amount, referrer) payable (send some BNB) 3. (Keeper or user) calls claimDailyReward() or distributePending() daily 4. To exit early: call redeem() - sends 10 ASTERDAO as trigger? (or just call with param), gets % principal back, rest burn
devdoc.title: ASTERDAO Staking & Referral Skeleton (NOT PRODUCTION READY)
